title: The Composer’s Prompt

publisher: Zenodo (default; confirm original publisher before deposit)
description: The Composer’s Prompt: Music Theory and Harmony for Computational Music Prompting is a 159-page educational digital book addressing the application of music theory and harmony to computational music prompting. Its coverage extends from intervals, modes, and chord functions to musical form, audio-generation specifications, and verification. The book is intended as an instructional and practical reference for musicians, educators, and users of generative music systems. It is not presented as a peer-reviewed study or as experimentally validated research. This record concerns the final copyright-protected PDF edition and not the separately licensed interactive edition.
